top_choice_rationale: P002 (Hyman, Brangwynne, Rosen) credits the establishment of liquid-liquid phase separation as a thermodynamic, phase-diagram description of intracellular organisation: in vitro demixing of multivalent macromolecules at defined concentrations and liquid-like P granules and nucleoli are well documented, and the citation is worded narrowly so it does not claim the unsettled physiological roles of condensates. I acknowledge it is younger and less widely supported than P001, and that the three-name cut leaves out Pappu and Mittag, so I rank P001 second as the mature, cleanly attributed alternative, then the PROTAC proposals (P003 with Ciulli before P004 with Handa, since the PROTAC strand is the more coherent single citation), and no award last.
recusal_note: none apparent from profile beyond field proximity: my lipid, interface and amyloid work is thematically close to P002 but I have no recorded collaboration with any named candidate; Lund colleagues Linke and Somfai are on the committee.
